why: TD-01 copied four alias texts from skill_cad_interpretation onto skill_drawing_reading without removing the originals. Both holders are active and embedded, both score exactly 1.0000 against the phrase, and the winner is decided by index order — a nondeterministic assignment no floor can arbitrate. The corpus already names skill_drawing_reading as skill_cad_interpretation's successor, so electing the successor is the reading consistent with the ratified crosswalk rather than a new taxonomy judgement. It is still an ELECTION, and elections have a reviewer: nothing reads this file.
wired_into: nothing. db:embed:skills and db:decollide:aliases read data/taxonomy/decollided-aliases.json only. Ratifying means MOVING these rows into that file in a reviewed PR; parseCleanupProposal refuses to load this one if it is marked RATIFIED in place.
measured_cost: De-electing these four removes the only holders of CAD, drawing padhna, read engineering drawings and technical drawing from the cnc-programming legacy slug — skill_drawing_reading's copies live in cnc-machining. Scope-level coverage loss, quantified in 5b-alias-collision-cleanup.json under scope_orphaned. It is a cost of the election, not a defect in it, and it disappears once per-label resolution (TAX-6) replaces slug-scoped retrieval.
